caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a carved backrest and curved legs. The wood is brown with visible grain detail, and the top of the backrest has an ornate, wavy carved edge and a central circular detail. The central splat, or vertical part of the backrest, features an intricate, symmetrical cut-out pattern. The seat of the chair is upholstered in a dark brown or deep maroon fabric, decorated with a colorful floral pattern that includes red, blue, yellow, green, and pink shades. The chair is positioned at a slight angle, showing three of its four legs fully, all of which are slightly curved. The background is plain and off-white. There is a small signature near the bottom right corner.
title: Side Chair
